moveHint: Order and bill move together. Shares already paid stay with the bill.
tableEmpty: This table has not ordered anything yet.
pickCourseHint: Tap to pick the course, drag to move the whole course
recallCourse: Recall it: the course goes back to the queue and off the kitchen screens
fireRemaining: Fire the lines still queued on this course
fireNow: Fire this course to the kitchen now
cancelProposal: Cancel the proposal: the course goes back to draft, the kitchen does not see it
discountOnRecord: It stays on record with your name: it explains the difference at the end of service.
searchDishAll: Search a dish across the whole menu…
clearUnsent: Clear the lines not sent yet
closeAndBill: Close the order and open the bill

err.noOrderThisService: No orders in this service. New orders only open in the current service: go back to today to start one.
err.orderDeletedElsewhere: Order deleted from another device — unsent lines stay here and go again with Send.
err.lineDown: Connection down: the order was not sent, the kitchen cannot see it. Try again when it is back.
err.pendingRows_one: {{count}} line has not gone to the kitchen yet. Send it or confirm it as discarded.
err.pendingRows_other: {{count}} lines have not gone to the kitchen yet. Send them or confirm them as discarded.
err.receiptNotSent: The receipt did not go out: retry it from the bill, in Payments.

toast.toInvoice: Bill closed, invoice pending: it can still be issued from the bill.
toast.draftRestored_one: {{count}} dish not sent since last time: draft restored, it is not in the kitchen.
toast.draftRestored_other: {{count}} dishes not sent since last time: draft restored, it is not in the kitchen.
toast.roundRepeated: Round repeated in the {{uscita}} — check it and send
toast.courseUnfired: {{uscita}}: fire cancelled, back in the queue

dishOffMenu: This dish is no longer on the menu

presence.oneNow: {{nome}} is working on it too · just now
presence.oneSince: {{nome}} is working on it too · for {{minuti}}′

sent.atPass: Proposed at the pass — waiting to be fired
sent.firedWaiting_one: Course in the kitchen; another is waiting at the pass
sent.firedWaiting_other: Course in the kitchen; {{count}} are waiting at the pass

bill.receiptQrHint: The guest scans it and gets the digital receipt on their phone.

close.total: The {{importo}} total moves to table {{tavolo}}'s bill. No dishes can be added after that.
close.pending_one: {{count}} line has not gone to the kitchen yet and will be deleted.
close.pending_other: {{count}} lines have not gone to the kitchen yet and will be deleted.

void.title: Void {{piatto}}
void.hint: The line stays on the books as waste, with who voided it and why.

removeOrder.title: Delete the order for Table {{tavolo}}
removeOrder.hint: All lines go, including those already in the kitchen. The reason stays in the activity log.

move.lineHint: Which course does it go to?
